<thought>From the ¹H NMR spectrum, the singlet at 1.79 ppm integrates to 3 H (one CH₃), the singlet at 1.92 ppm integrates to 6 H (two CH₃), and the singlet at 2.67 ppm integrates to 6 H (two CH₃). Summing gives 15 H, which corresponds to 15 ÷ 3 = 5 methyl (CH₃) groups.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
